title: Various beers under Molson Coors banner recalled Canada-wide
summary: Various beers, both alcoholic and non-alcoholic, under the Molson Coors banner have been recalled across Canada due to pieces of metal, according to Health Canada.

image.caption: Various Molson Coors products have been recalled due to a presence of metal. (Steven Senne/Associated Press)

blocks.text: Various beers, both alcoholic and non-alcoholic, under the Molson Coors banner have been recalled across Canada due to pieces of metal, according to Health Canada.
No reports of harm, company says
In a statement Wednesday afternoon, Molson Coors said the following drinks are affected in Atlantic Canada, including those packaged at the St. John's brewery.

items: Molson Canadian 12 x 355 mL, 15 x 355 mL, 24 x 473 mL (Case codes J216, K016 and K136),
Molson Canadian Light 12 x 355 mL (Case code J246),
Coors Light 8 x 355 mL, 12 x 355 mL, 15 x 355 mL, 24 x 355 mL (Case codes J286, J246, K026 or K146),
Blue Moon Non-Alcoholic Belgian White 6 x 355 mL, 24 x 355 mL (Case codes H216, K096),
Blue Moon Belgian White Ale 4 x 473 mL, 6 x 473 mL, 12 x 355 mL, 24 x 355 mL, 24 x 473 mL (Case codes H286, J116, J256),
Blue Moon Mango Wheat 4 x 473 mL, 24 x 473 mL (Case code K026),
Blue Moon Light 12 x 355 mL (Case code K156),
Black Horse 8 x 355 mL (Case code J246)
and India 12 x 355 mL (Case code J246).

blocks.text: The company said any product matching the above case codes should be returned to the point of purchase, and that retailers have been asked to immediately stop selling them.
"We have not received any notification of consumer harm to date," wrote spokesperson Ryan McKenna.
